value.title: Car in a Tree
value.synopsis: The Firebuds must save Piston after he gets stuck in a tree.

value.title: Dalmatian Day
value.synopsis: The Firebuds have to round up four loose Dalmatian puppies at the fire station open house.

value.title: Hubcap Heist
value.synopsis: Bo and the Firebuds must stop a pair of wily art thieves.

value.title: Food Truck Fiasco
value.synopsis: The Firebuds help Fernando the Food Truck get to his café in time for the lunch rush.

value.title: Treehouse Trouble
value.synopsis: The Firebuds work together to build a backyard treehouse.

value.title: The Getaway Car That Got Away
value.synopsis: The Firebuds track down a getaway car that they accidentally helped get away.

value.title: Picnic Pile-Up
value.synopsis: Violet and Axl’s picnic with their families get interrupted by a surprise emergency.

value.title: Duo Dash
value.synopsis: Axl is nervous about doing well in her school’s Duo Dash Speed Race.

value.title: The Not-So Haunted House
value.synopsis: The Firebuds host a not-so-haunted house for little cars, but Iggy and Rod crash the party.

value.title: Halloween Heroes
value.synopsis: The Firebuds stop a Halloween candy bandit.

value.title: Sleepover Stakeout
value.synopsis: Jayden plans a sleepover stakeout to catch the thief of his new invention.

value.title: Rescue Club
value.synopsis: Carly wants to join the school's Rescue Club, even though she's not a rescue vehicle like the Firebuds.

value.title: Cliffhanger
value.synopsis: Iggy and Rod fall onto a narrow ledge and The Buds must learn to do things the safe way in order to rescue them.

value.title: The Very First Fire
value.synopsis: A park play fort catches fire and Bo knows The Buds can put it out.

value.title: Marsh Mayhem
value.synopsis: Kid reporter, June, gets famous at school after reporting a sighting of an urban legend.

value.title: The Art of Friendship
value.synopsis: The Firebuds create a giant mobile to cheer up kids in the hospital.

value.title: Lights Out
value.synopsis: Iggy and Rod find themselves in need of The Buds' help when a storm causes a blackout.

value.title: Handle with Car
value.synopsis: Flash discovers lizard eggs, but must calm down to take them to a reptile sanctuary.

value.title: Transmission Impossible
value.synopsis: When the Gearbox Grove's 100th Van-iversity cake is stolen by Wayne and Wiley Riley, the Firebuds must rescue it.

value.title: Carkour
value.synopsis: Piston tries to learn carkour to impress his hero.

value.title: Care-A-Van Club
value.synopsis: Violet tries to rescue her hero's kitten from a tall jump ramp.

value.title: Mud About You
value.synopsis: Bo and Flash go out and look for rescues after a storm lifts.

value.title: River Rescue
value.synopsis: Bo fails to watch a young wee-hicle, and they both end up stuck on a raft in the creek.

value.title: Big Tread
value.synopsis: Piston must overcome his fears of mythical monster trucks to save his lost friends.

value.title: Hanukkah Hullabaloo
value.synopsis: Bo decides to decorate his house to celebrate Hanukkah, but things get out of control.
